control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: fire on HT-9006 during commissioning of replacement equipment

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9006 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9006 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically parking, chocking and restraining equipment. HT-9006 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 3 March 2015 an incident occurred on HT-9006 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
